doc_summary: `native_vanilla_game_event(dimension, event, pos, cause, cancel)`, for each game event on a server, `cause` the network id of the entity that caused it (None for none; the affected block state is not passed) (`minecraft:step`, `minecraft:block_place`...) before its listeners hear it. Set `cancel` and sculk sensors, wardens and allays do not hear it. `native_game_event` still hears every event. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:vanilla_game_event@.
